subject: Important Update: Upcoming Changes to Your Account
body: Dear Customer, We wanted to inform you about some upcoming changes to our service that may affect your account. These changes are aimed at improving our platform and providing you with a better user experience. Please review the attached document for detailed information on the changes and how they may impact you. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services. Best regards, The Support Team
